title: Persistence Mechanism Reality Audit
objective: Statically audit QuantMind database, ORM, engine, session, transaction, migration, test database, configuration, and secret-handling reality; select the future Implementation Ledger persistence boundary without implementing it.
scope: Code-backed persistence reality audit with formal, legacy, test, deprecated, and unconfirmed classification.
Explicit future Ledger persistence selection and A-E option comparison.
Project Memory updates that preserve unimplemented Ledger status.
Bounded validator and targeted tests for audit evidence, accepted ADR immutability, handoff, and absence of runtime implementation.
One immutable Implementation Run and one local commit.
explicit_non_goals: No Ledger domain model, Repository interface, ORM model, database table, migration, Manifest Indexer, Git consistency service, API, or UI.
No TDX, Dataset Snapshot, Factor DSL, Optimization, Validation runtime, Registry, LightGBM, Qlib, Risk, or other business implementation.
No database connection, migration execution, service startup, Electron startup, model run, Qlib run, or Factor Lab campaign.
No accepted ADR, Factor Lab, dependency, lockfile, runtime configuration, or secret change.
No implementation of QM2-P0-002A1b or later tasks.

known_limitations: Static audit cannot prove live topology, installed package versions, deployed schema, permissions, SSL, replica lag, or production call frequency.
Operational execution and ordering of manual SQL upgrades is unconfirmed; no ordered runner, applied-version ledger, checksum, or downgrade path is code-confirmed.
No database integration test ran and no shared isolated PostgreSQL fixture or CI PostgreSQL service is confirmed.
The explicit quantmind2 schema is an engineering choice whose privileges and operational approval remain unconfirmed.
Context schema v1 cannot encode exact next task QM2-P0-002A1b, so machine-readable task lists retain legal parent QM2-P0-002A1.
The bounded validator is not a general JSON Schema implementation.
The containing commit cannot be embedded self-referentially; Git history resolves it after commit.
unresolved_questions: What controlled deployment command applies incremental migrations and records order/checksums?
Can the deployment role create and use the quantmind2 PostgreSQL schema?
What isolated PostgreSQL target and CI service will repository integration tests use?
What are the retention, rebuild SLA, backup, and disaster-recovery requirements for the derived Ledger index?
Does formalizing a migration-version mechanism require a later ADR or operations approval?
rollback_information: Revert the single containing commit. No database, migration, data, API, runtime, model, Qlib, UI, dependency, lockfile, configuration, accepted ADR, or Factor Lab rollback is required.
security_impact: No runtime changed; the audit records credential-bearing defaults and a possible full database URL log without reproducing secret values.
data_lineage_impact: No data changed; Git Implementation Runs remain authoritative and PostgreSQL remains a planned rebuildable query index.
